opening.argument: The video is principally an instructional walkthrough for buying or redeeming digital credits. It identifies the subject as “How To Buy ITunes Gift Card In Taiwan - Wallet Codes,” then demonstrates kiosk payment, including obtaining a receipt and paying at the cashier. The Apple ID creation and email verification screens show account setup as part of that process, followed by a connected VPN and App Store gift-card redemption screen. The description does promote registration for P Points and free diamonds, but that promotion alone does not establish deceptive conduct, unauthorized data use, payment loss, or a completed transaction. The purpose of the VPN, the validity of the code, and whether redemption succeeds remain unclear.
